## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it is needed.

## Lifecycle impact

Describe affected states, events, obligations, retries, and recovery behavior.
Write "None" when the change has no lifecycle impact.

## Verification

List the checks performed and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Failure and restart behavior is defined where relevant.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when executable behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, conversation contents, or session data are included.
- [ ] Third-party provenance and notices were updated if material was introduced.
- [ ] Security implications were considered.
